title: Security
summary: Audit the box and look at it as an attacker would: Lynis, nmap, debsecan and the rest.
consent: These tools probe networks and read packets. fail2ban installs stopped: switch it on separately, on the Security page.
notes: Kept fresher than the other kits: from outside the box's control, so refreshed daily when online.
Greenbone/OpenVAS is not on the box (gigabytes of RAM, no armhf build): run it from a PC on the hotspot against the box.
